Featured: AI Commerce

Sky, Freeman's AI commerce chatbot

Led the launch of Sky, Freeman's AI commerce chatbot, as a key stakeholder and build contributor on product and pricing features. Live on Freeman's commerce store. Sky helps exhibitors find and buy what they need for their events, directly in chat.

Sky's product and pricing features let exhibitors ask about products and services in plain language, like "How much is a 6ft draped table?" or "What carpet do you have?", and get instant answers from their own show's catalog.

  • Show-specific results: every product and price Sky returns matches exactly what is available in that customer's show catalog.
  • Visual product cards: each result shows the product image, dimensions, price, and options such as carpet colors, with a carousel to browse similar items.
  • One click to shop: customers go straight from the chat to the product details or the full category in their show's store.

Sky in action

Future release goal: side-by-side product comparison and more advanced shopping features to drive cross-selling and up-selling.

Spotlight: Roundtrip Ready

Roundtrip Ready is Freeman Transportation's bundled program for exhibitors: roundtrip shipping plus material handling in one coordinated plan, with 10% off both at participating shows, one invoice, and transparent upfront pricing. It applies to LTL domestic roundtrip shipments where the exhibitor books both inbound and outbound shipping with Freeman, and includes dedicated concierge-style support and stress-free post-show returns.

My team drove traffic to the program on Freeman.com, helping Roundtrip Ready reach $7.8M in combined revenue, up 42% year over year.
